data.long_meaning: Deepansh is a Sanskrit name derived from the words 'deep' (depth) and 'ansh' (symbol). The name is often interpreted as 'the symbol of depth' or 'the depth of symbol'. In Hindu mythology, Deepansh is a name given to the divine light that illuminates the deepest recesses of the soul. The name Deepansh carries the meaning “Deep + Ansh (Depth + Symbol)” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Deepansh usually hope their child will grow to embody deep + ansh (depth + symbol) and live with faith, good character and purpose.
